name: _fonts.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _fonts.scss — the type ramp: .ttl-xxl..xxs display classes + .txt body
//  classes. All Raleway, deliberately thin weights (100–300) for the
//  portfolio's light aesthetic. Sizes/letter-spacing scale up across the
//  layout-{320..3840} breakpoints — titles grow ~4× from phone to 4K.
//  Class bodies live in _placeholders.scss as %TTL_*/%TXT_* so component
//  sheets can @extend a single level without importing this whole file.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// All typography uses Raleway exclusively.
// Titles: weight 100–200. Body text: weight 100–300. No 700.

.ttl {
  &-xxl,
  &-xl,
  &-lg,
  &-md,
  &-sm,
  &-xs,
  &-xxs {
    @extend %TTL_BASE;
  }

  &-xxl {
    @extend %TTL_XXL;
  }

  &-xl {
    @extend %TTL_XL;
  }

  &-lg {
    @extend %TTL_LG;
  }

  &-md {
    @extend %TTL_MD;
  }

  &-sm {
    @extend %TTL_SM;
  }

  &-xs {
    @extend %TTL_XS;
  }

  &-xxs {
    @extend %TTL_XXS;
  }
}

.txt {
  &-lg,
  &-md,
  &-sm,
  &-xs {
    @extend %TXT_BASE;
  }

  &-lg {
    @extend %TXT_LG;
  }

  &-md {
    @extend %TXT_MD;
  }

  &-sm {
    @extend %TXT_SM;
  }

  &-xs {
    @extend %TXT_XS;
  }
}

.ttl-special {
  @extend %TTL_BASE;
  @extend %TTL_SPECIAL;
}
